system.description:
High plateaus and rocky slopes, with thin soil and hard weather. The wind never stops and the ground gives little. People here grow lean and stubborn, and settle things with their heads down.

Talent: one Might die to d12, one Finesse die to d8.

  • Headbutt. You learn the Trip Technique: Melee, Stress, Prone.
  • Tough Hide. Gain Physical Resistance +1, stacking with Equipment Resistance.
